description: A doctor-approved health platform to help you and your child track asthma symptoms anytime, anywhere. Aluna is a portable spirometry test device paired with an interactive mobile game kids will love.

Bottneuro develops digital biomarkers, brain imaging- and neuromodulation technologies to become the leading provider of diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease. Products are highly personalised and suited for home use.
Dexter simplifies suturing and dissection tasks in general surgery, gynecology and urology. Hence, millions of patients can get access to best-in-class minimally invasive care.
Digital vaults for personal documents and passwords, technology for digital document delivery and secure file sharing for asset managers and bank clients.

Diagnostic of cardiac arrhythmia outside of the clinic with minimal impact on everyday life. Intelligent digital cross-linking of the relevant stakeholders. Improvement of access, prevention, therapy and diagnostic for patients with suspicion of cardiac arrhythmia.
Medication-free, at home treatment for depression. Offering a combination of brain stimulation through the Flow headset and psychological treatment through the Flow app.

Digital procurement and sales platform in healthcare. Through integration with local ERP systems, processes in procurement and sales become up to 70% more efficient. With the vision of the hub for market information, hystrix acts as a pivot between healthcare providers and suppliers - fast, simple, digital.
World's first medical grade, certified vital signs sensor system for smartphones measuring blood pressure, body temperature and heart rate.
Limula offers a modular solution for on-demand and at-scale manufacturing of gene and cell therapies in a single device.
PeriVision combines artificial intelligence (AI), virtual reality (VR) and the cloud to build the next generation systems to test and understand visual function.
Implant for sacroiliac (SI) joint fixation using a minimally invasive technique via an easily accessible incision resulting in a simpler, more efficient surgery which carries fewer risks.
